payload.friendly_name: The activation set: ActivationConfig and the reserved activation operations
payload.purpose_context: ADR-0020 makes active charters a stored, top-level resource. Core's deny-list work codes against the contract now, so ADR-0022 D5 puts the activation set in the first 0.x minor after 0.1.0: closed schemas, every operation declared in full and reserved, refusal codes, conditional headers, lint rules and scenarios that pin each reserved operation.
payload.purpose_tldr: Declare the activation document and every activation operation in the charter contract, answering 501 until built, so core can code its deny-list against it.

payload.question: Accept the 14 pre-spec recommendations (provenance/contextActivations/appliedPresets left out; skill required-only default; 11 activatable kinds; cascade array or [all]; packs {packId, version?}; requiredBy/violations on shared Problem; four effective reads declared; JSON Schema + OpenAPI mirror with parity test; @reserved 501 pins; 0.2.0-SNAPSHOT; #46 untouched; ADR-0020 amended in place, no oauth2 scopes)?

payload.final_answer: All 14 as recommended (operator ruling 2026-10-31, relayed by the orchestrator session).
